title: Saying goodnight on purpose to the people you live with
dek: A real goodnight takes ten seconds, and it can change how a household feels at the end of a long Monday.
body: In a lot of homes, the day ends in pieces. One person falls asleep on the couch, another is finishing dishes, and someone else is still in their room with headphones on. Nobody really says goodnight. Everyone just drifts off.

Saying it on purpose is a small fix. It means stopping what you are doing, finding the people you live with, and saying goodnight while looking at them. You can add one small thing, like a thank you for something they did today.
It can feel a little formal at first. It can also make a home feel calmer, and it gives the day a proper ending instead of letting it just run out.
Mondays are a good night to start, because everyone is tired and a little worn down by the first day of the week. That is often when a kind word lands best.
Before you turn off the lights tonight, find each person in your home and say goodnight. If you live alone, send the message to someone you care about instead.
